name: writesonic
description: Writesonic plugins for Claude Code: AI-search visibility (GEO) and Writesonic Agents workspace data.

plugins.name: writesonic
plugins.description:
Access AI search visibility (AEO/GEO) analytics across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and more. Track visibility score, citation share, share of voice, competitor performance, and brand sentiment using data from 500M+ real AI conversations across 50+ markets.

Claude connects multiple Writesonic reports in a single conversation - identifying gaps, surfacing trends, and pinpointing where to focus your GEO strategy.

plugins.name: writesonic-agents
plugins.description: Connect Writesonic Agents to Claude Code. Manage tasks, playbooks, grids, knowledge base, and pages from chat — triage work, follow what agents did, inspect playbook runs, read grids, search your Knowledge Base and Brand Kit, and pull Pages reports.
